headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2022, back when Adam Page vs. Lance Archer fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title in a Texas Death Match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.50 ? an outstanding performance from both sides. A bloody, brutal Texas Death Match, with the fight spilling backstage before the bell even rang ? Page threw Archer through a pane of glass and finally won with a Buckshot Lariat through a stack of tables, on the same show that saw Keith Lee's shock signing.
